232:150.en: 「The $$赤い彗星$$ name is no mere boast!」

232:263.en: 「$$ユニコーンガンダム$$!\nShow me that power!」

232:320.en: 「So you come, $$バナージ・リンクス$$...!」

232:386.en: 「Again you oppose me, $$アムロ・レイ$$...!」

232:476.en: 「I cannot dismiss you, $$ロンド・ベル$$...!」

232:571.en: 「Even $$カミーユ・ビダン$$ cannot stop me!」

232:602.en: 「Mercy for an old ally... One blow!」

232:841.en: 「I see... A fine young man has grown.」

232:1013.en: 「I won't take a minor foe lightly...!」

232:1201.en: 「This is another way to do it!」

232:1341.en: 「Looks like I must take the lead!」

232:1503.en: 「I must show I can do it...!」

232:1722.en: 「You can hardly call that a Gundam.」

232:1810.en: 「You mean to test me, $$アムロ・レイ$$...!」

232:1853.en: 「How far $$ロンド・ベル$$ has fallen...!」

232:1943.en: 「When true to your heart,\nI liked you」

232:2031.en: 「Speed alone cannot catch up to me!」

232:2348.en: 「$$アンジェロ$$ may weep to see this!」

232:2550.en: 「Ngh! Are you my equal, or even...!」

232:2640.en: 「$$赤い彗星$$'s name\nwill bear no stain!」

232:2789.en: 「$$アムロ・レイ$$...! I cannot lose to you!」

232:2828.en: 「I'll stop you here, $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

232:2869.en: 「As expected of $$ロンド・ベル$$! But...!」

232:3088.en: 「I never took you for a weakling...!」

232:3248.en: 「A foe who can corner even me...?」

232:3604.en: 「$$フル・フロンタル$$, this is unlike you...!」

232:3647.en: 「I will take the Box by force.」

232:3680.en: 「To keep the status quo, people bury\neven possibility. That is humanity.」

232:3747.en: 「Only we can fulfill the\nSpacenoids' cherished wish.」

232:3800.en: 「Don't fear. It's over in an instant.」

232:3839.en: 「To keep all humanity alive,\nwe can only act on our ideas.」

232:3910.en: 「I am merely acting in accordance\nwith humanity's collective will.」

232:3961.en: 「Understand that my actions\nare humanity's collective will.」

232:4010.en: 「The Box has meaning only when\nsomeone like me uses it.」

232:4224.en: 「It was careless to stand before me!」

232:4463.en: 「Heir to the Box,\nI'll say it now: you go no farther!」

232:4520.en: 「Now the Box's location is known,\nI can kill you without hesitation!」

232:4595.en: 「The possibility you speak of\nis a poison that sparks conflict!」

232:4654.en: 「$$バナージ$$, even showing possibility\nwon't change people at all!」

232:4723.en: 「You seem a gifted pilot,\nbut that ends here!」

232:4786.en: 「I'll free you from the days of\nagony under the Box's curse!」

232:4839.en: 「I cannot allow the beast of\npossibility to exist!」

232:4933.en: 「I'll end this now,\n$$マリーダ・クルス$$!」

232:4984.en: 「$$マリーダ・クルス$$...\nYou know full well my power!」

232:5041.en: 「$$ジンネマン$$, you'll regret dreaming\nof another possibility!」

232:5100.en: 「Dropping your grudge won't\nerase the past, $$ジンネマン$$!」

232:5157.en: 「Crew of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$,\nyou have outlived your use too.」

232:5210.en: 「I'll end our strange ties\nhere and now!」

232:5261.en: 「$$ロンド・ベル$$'s flagship sinks here!」

232:5302.en: 「$$ロンド・ベル$$, don't think you can\ndo as you please before me!」

232:5365.en: 「The legend of Gundam\nwill end right here!」

232:5418.en: 「$$アムロ$$, even gathering all humanity's\nunconscious won't change people!」

232:5477.en: 「I shall carry on the $$赤い彗星$$ name,\n$$シャア・アズナブル$$...!」

232:5544.en: 「One person and those around them\ncan't defeat me, $$カミーユ$$!」

232:5605.en: 「It's a pity, $$ハマーン$$.\nThat even you would leave me...!」

232:5662.en: 「$$ヒイロ$$, I crush the future you saw!」

232:5705.en: 「The future of the $$コーディネイター$$s\nis also up to me!」

232:5754.en: 「To avoid repeating mistakes,\npeople like me are needed!」

232:5819.en: 「So eager to recreate $$黒歴史$$,\n$$ロラン・セアック$$?」

232:5880.en: 「Thinking all humanity can become\n$$イノベイター$$s is a fantasy!」

232:5945.en: 「Connecting people's wills with song\nis nothing but a sham!」

232:6000.en: 「Not even you can move my heart!」

232:6039.en: 「Since you're a warmonger,\nyou're no different from us!」

232:6094.en: 「No miracle will happen...!\nThat is how reality works!」

232:6151.en: 「I'll eliminate all who use\nthe power of the $$スフィア$$s!」

232:6254.en: 「Can't dodge this many Mega Particle Cannons...!」

232:6559.en: 「If you believe in the light ahead...」

232:6598.en: 「Then I will simply wipe it out!」

232:6789.en: 「Once you let me strike back,\nthe result was already clear...!」

232:7035.en: 「I wasn't given the name $$赤い彗星$$\nfor nothing.」

232:7090.en: 「You thought a frame this huge\nwould be easy to hit, I see.」

232:7145.en: 「That's far enough, $$バナージ$$.\nYou'd best not try anything rash.」

232:7204.en: 「I thought you'd grown a little,\nbut I seem to have been mistaken.」

232:7263.en: 「Give up and acknowledge me as\nthe Box's owner, $$バナージ$$」

232:7316.en: 「For the heir to the Box's curse,\nyou lack stature.」

232:7367.en: 「You can't protect the Box or Princess like this.」

232:7410.en: 「The Black Lion's power\nis not yours to master.」

232:7461.en: 「That's enough, $$マリーダ・クルス$$.\nYou've fought well enough.」

232:7516.en: 「$$マリーダ・クルス$$,\nthis is your limit.」

232:7565.en: 「No need to hold back now, $$ジンネマン$$.」

232:7649.en: 「Even $$ロンド・ベル$$ are but\nbabes before me.」

232:7763.en: 「You cannot bring out\nthe Gundam's true worth.」

232:7814.en: 「Do you think this little pressure\ncan do anything to me?」

232:7875.en: 「$$アムロ$$,\ndon't think me $$シャア$$'s equal...!」

232:7926.en: 「$$シャア・アズナブル$$,\nyou are already a finished man...!」

232:8032.en: 「Just a woman swept away by emotion,\n$$ハマーン$$...!」

232:8081.en: 「Did you think I hadn't\nconsidered the unexpected?」

232:8188.en: 「You don't seem to realize\nyou've picked a reckless fight.」

232:8309.en: 「Did I get your hopes up a little?」

232:8346.en: 「Such an attack can't stop this unit.」

232:8389.en: 「As you see, the armor is off scale.」

232:8428.en: 「A word of advice: stopping here\nwould be better for you.」

232:8483.en: 「Are you fine with this warped world\ncontinuing as it has?」

232:8544.en: 「No matter how you struggle,\nmy victory won't waver...!」

232:8648.en: 「You defy me...!\nI, the vessel of humanity's will...!」

232:8705.en: 「This machine isn't one that stops\nover such minor damage...!」

232:8764.en: 「That's the spirit, $$バナージ・リンクス$$!」

232:8803.en: 「That's far enough, $$バナージ$$!\nYou'll regret your choice!」

232:8864.en: 「No matter how you struggle,\nthis battle's outcome won't change!」

232:8925.en: 「An ordinary person's struggling\nstops being funny at this point!」

232:8976.en: 「You surely understand what\nreleasing the Box would mean!」

232:9041.en: 「Guh!\nBeasts of possibility gang up on me!」

232:9092.en: 「This power...!\nIt isn't $$マリーダ・クルス$$'s alone...!」

232:9147.en: 「Defeating me won't create the\nworld you want, $$ジンネマン$$!」

232:9208.en: 「Will you obstruct me to the end,\n$$ネェル・アーガマ$$!」

232:9263.en: 「Masterful work, $$ロンド・ベル$$!\nBut this is as far as it goes!」

232:9320.en: 「You'd defeat me,\nand carve a new legend, Gundam?」

232:9369.en: 「Why don't you see the foolish masses\nwill only exploit that power?!」

232:9432.en: 「$$アムロ$$...!\nAs expected, you stand in my way!」

232:9487.en: 「So be it, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!\nLet's settle this!」

232:9544.en: 「Will you leave this world, headed\nfor collapse, as it is, $$カミーユ$$?!」

232:9605.en: 「$$ハマーン$$!\nNever have I hated you so deeply!」

232:9693.en: 「I can't die without doing\nwhat I must do!」

232:9744.en: 「To think I'd be driven\ninto such a corner...!」

232:9836.en: 「Guh!\nAt this rate the Box is released...!」

232:9889.en: 「Why can't you see that your actions\nclose off possibility!」

232:9954.en: 「Very well...\nI'll salute their good fight here.」

232:10060.en: 「Light born of people... Something this warm...! How futile...」

232:10127.en: 「I leave to you... what you think must be done...」

232:10170.en: 「Too slow, $$バナージ$$. At that speed, I'll see this story's end first.」

232:10259.en: 「Very well. From here it's a race. I'll take my leave for now.」

232:10373.en: 「It's fine, Captain $$アンジェロ$$. $$バナージ$$ speaks of his stance on the game.」

232:10444.en: 「True, it feels half-finished... Surely you yourself want to know what comes next?」

232:10535.en: 「Oh dear... We do need some rest.」

232:10588.en: 「Games are meant to be fun to play.」
